Generative AI was used to assist with initial drafts of some localized text. All final translations were manually reviewed and edited.
No AI-generated artwork, animation, audio, code, or live-generated content is included in the game. All visual assets shown in the game and on the store page were created by human artists.
A few icons in the game are in made by taking a screenshot and adding a filter over the screenshot.

I know many players have reservations about AI-generated content, so I want to be upfront about exactly how it was used in this game.
I'm an ordinary gamer who has played games for almost twenty years and always dreamed of making one of my own. But I can't write code, and I've never been trained in art or music. This game exists because generative AI filled those gaps for me: parts of the code were written with the help of AI coding tools; some character, environment, and UI art was created with image-generation models, then hand-picked and adjusted by me; some animation, music, and sound effects were also made with AI tools.
Everything that makes it an actual game, though — the design, the balancing, the game feel, and every "is this fun?" decision — was done by me, across hundreds of playtests. The game contains no live-generated AI content.
For me, AI wasn't an assembly line making a game in my place. It's what let an ordinary player finally build the game he'd been dreaming about. I hope some of that comes through when you play — and I'd genuinely welcome your feedback.

The voice of R.E.I.K.A, the AI companion character, is generated using AI text-to-speech technology same as the voice lines of the end dialogue; all other game content — code, art, design, and writing — is handmade.

Generative AI was used during the development process to assist and improve efficiency. Specifically, some in-game art assets (such as UI icons and backgrounds) were generated by AI and subsequently refined by human artists. Additionally, AI-assisted tools were utilized to help with the writing and debugging of some foundational code. We assure you that all final art assets and core logic code presented to players have been manually reviewed and optimized by our development team. There is no live-generated AI content or code during actual gameplay.

AI NPC 对话
玩家可以通过文字输入与游戏中的 NPC 自由交流。游戏内AI会根据各个 NPC 预先设定的性格、身份、当前情绪、角色关系、既有记忆以及游戏剧情进度，实时生成符合角色设定的对话内容。玩家的输入将用于生成本次对话回复。
AI Agent 剧情内容
游戏中的部分叙事内容由 AI Agent 系统实时参与生成。系统会根据游戏预先设定的世界观、角色资料、剧情规则、玩家选择及当前游戏状态，生成相应的角色反应和剧情文本。AI Agent 的生成范围受到游戏既定设定和规则的限制，不会完全脱离预设世界观自由生成。
AI 辅助美术内容
在游戏开发过程中，我们使用了生成式 AI 工具辅助制作或处理部分 CG、背景图和角色立绘。相关美术素材并非在玩家游玩过程中实时生成，而是在开发阶段生成、筛选和调整后作为固定资源收录于游戏中。
内容安全措施
实时生成的内容主要用于非成人的剧情叙事和角色互动。我们对玩家输入及 AI 输出设置了内容过滤和安全限制，以杜绝生成违法、色情、仇恨、暴力煽动及其他不适当内容的可能性。

CielChan uses generative AI to create real-time conversation responses and voice synthesis. By default, a local AI model generates text responses, and bundled TTS engines convert those responses to speech directly on your device.
All core functionality is fully available offline, and no internet connection is required to use the application.
Optional cloud-based AI and voice features are available for advanced users. When enabled, these features may send text or audio data to selected third-party providers using user-provided API keys.
The AI model, voice synthesis, and core systems are included in the download, allowing CielChan to function independently offline.

The AI is character-based. Each character has their own model and will respond and react to player interaction in a specific way, each providing a unique challenge. As the player progresses through the year in Millennium Whisper, they will build relationships with the characters as all interactions are fed to the models and the characters rate their affection levels towards the player. The challenge comes from the player needing to juggle their social relationship with all the characters at once as characters have the ability to communicate with eachother by spreading rumours thereby allowing neglected characters to sabotage the player's relationship with other characters. The characters will also accept or reject date invites from the player or author their own date invitations. At the end of the game the AIs evaluates which character the player ends up with.

Regarding AI usage: The game employs AI in only two areas
1. Character voice lines (disabled by default)
The ultra-large script (800k words) makes authentic voice acting financially unaffordable for our small studio.
2. "Seek Answers" function in the game lobby’s Sosoth (NPC) interaction interface
For entertainment purposes, we used AI chat.
What we can guarantee: Beyond these, translation, scripts, design, art, animation, and other game components absolutely did not use AI.

GnollHack includes Gnoll Overseer, an optional AI assistant that uses third-party generative AI models to answer players’ questions in a text chat. Players can ask about game mechanics or request help with their current game situation, which is shared with the AI as context only when they use the feature. Overseer only produces chat replies: it cannot take actions in the game or generate images, audio, or other in-game content. Its instructions restrict it to GnollHack topics, and it uses strict system guardrails and the AI providers’ safety filters to prevent harmful, offensive, or illegal responses.
